title: Operational Handover
subtitle: From Project Delivery to Operational Ownership
description: Deploying a product is not the same as transferring operational ownership. Marcus and IT Operations refuse to accept ownership without verified administrator runbooks, incident response validation, and a mandatory 14-day hypercare window. Ensure the receiving team can independently operate, troubleshoot, and maintain the system.

stakeholders.name: Marcus
stakeholders.agenda: Enforcing 2 AM operational readiness, step-by-step failure runbooks, and a mandatory 14-day hypercare window before signing off.

stakeholders.name: Aarav Kapoor
stakeholders.agenda: Guiding the transition from project delivery into genuine operational ownership and organizational sustainability.

stakeholders.name: Daniel
stakeholders.agenda: Transferring technical operational knowledge so the engineering team is unblocked for future development cycles.

stakeholders.name: Martha
stakeholders.agenda: Coordinating training workshops and tracking operational handover deliverables in the transition calendar.

objectives.label: Build verified operational handover package matching 6 runbooks to requirements
Validate incident response sequence for INC-0318 employee login triage
Design 14-day progressive hypercare timeline across 3 operational phases
Authorize formal operational handover protocol with IT Operations sign-off

deliverables: Incident Triage SOP & Knowledge Transfer Plan
